confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Hoi An prices, not live booking pages or current listings. Restaurant, coffee, and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, especially the 3-star rate, which is seasonal and includes taxes and fees. July is a peak tourist month, so accommodation may run above the shoulder-season level. The FX observation comes from search summaries that attribute the 15 Oct 2026 figure to the RBA exchange-rates page. I did not open the RBA page directly, and I could not confirm the 16 Oct figure from an RBA source.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to central Vietnam tourist towns, mainly Da Nang and Hue, with Nha Trang as a cross-check for resort-style pricing. Accommodation anchors reflect Hoi An's Ancient Town and An Hoi/An Bang guesthouse and hotel areas.
